BiblicalUsage: Jibchar is Ibhar, a son of David born in Jerusalem. In 2 Samuel 5:15, Ibhar also, and Elishua. The fuller story is told on the Ibhar, Son of David profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Ibhar belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
